name:
Dragon Ball Z: Extreme
Butoden Update
formal_name:
Dragon Ball Z: Extreme
Butoden Update
description:
This update brings new content
to the game:
-More than 10 new Z-Assists
characters including Goku (Farmer),
Mira, Towa, Broly SS4…
-Training Mode
-Extreme Survival mode
-Online Battle Mode to fight friends
around the world
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
